shared_page.surface_width: min(100%, role max-width); never scale the surface with transforms
shared_page.overflow: visible vertically; no required content clipping or horizontal scroll
shared_page.surface_frame: 1px solid line; border-radius:0; background:field; position:relative; overflow:hidden

identity_accessibility.mechanism: One visually hidden text node named Kymaean inside the identity group; exact C0 and O3 SVGs are aria-hidden decorative geometry to prevent duplicate announcement.
identity_accessibility.c0_svg: aria-hidden=true; focusable=false; currentColor; exact canonical path geometry unchanged
identity_accessibility.o3_svg: aria-hidden=true; focusable=false; currentColor; exact canonical path/stroke geometry unchanged
identity_accessibility.diagnostics: O3_SOLO and NO_O3 retain the same single hidden accessible name; hidden visual geometry must not remove the accessible brand name.
identity_accessibility.visible_text_duplication: Do not add a second visible text spelling of KYMÆAN inside scored surfaces.

content.heading: Primary information remains clear.
content.body: Supporting text explains the situation without changing the hierarchy.

review_layout.wide: Role sections stack vertically; within each role the four variants form a responsive comparison row only when all four fit without shrinking below their native max-width; otherwise wrap naturally. No CSS transform scaling.
review_layout.width_320: One column in exact review_surface_order; each surface width:100%; native max-width acts only as a ceiling; vertical growth allowed.

diagnostic_behavior.FULL: show exact C0 + exact O3 + TYP F1 + MAT F1 + STA F2
diagnostic_behavior.NEUTRAL_TYP: only typography role vector changes to TYP CNEG; exact identity/material/state and layout remain
diagnostic_behavior.O3_SOLO: hide only C0 visual geometry; preserve its layout slot in APP/WEB horizontal roles and preserve prelude spacing in ACQUISITION
diagnostic_behavior.NO_O3: hide only O3 visual geometry; preserve its allocated inline/block measure

responsive_rules.state_zone: one column at <=520px; three equal columns above
responsive_rules.brand_group: may wrap only between identity group and synthetic scope/navigation; C0 and O3 relationship itself must not reorder
responsive_rules.acquisition: prelude remains vertical; O3 width becomes min(340px,88%,available width); no universal ratio inference

stress_execution.resize_200: set document root font-size to 200% while preserving CSS viewport width; no role/variant-specific rescue
stress_execution.text_spacing: add +0.12em letter spacing, +0.16em word spacing, line-height floor 1.5 and paragraph/block spacing floor 2em where applicable
stress_execution.forced_colors: Canvas/CanvasText/Highlight with forced-color-adjust:auto; C0/O3 currentColor geometry, focus ring and selected witness remain visible; MAT decorative channels may flatten

construction_freeze: After first specimen materialization, role geometry, identity sizes/gaps, accessibility semantics, typography vectors, MAT/STA values, content, diagnostics, review order/layout, responsive rules, browser modes and source rules may not be retuned. Mechanical repair may only restore this exact contract.
non_authority: These defaults create no final lockup, final wordmark/typeface, production token, CLR-01 reentry, implementation, final identity or Phase-C authority.
